drafter.private_reasoning: Do not disclose client’s bottom-line number. Keep the draft moving by preserving structure, tightening release/confidentiality, and asking opposing counsel to insert their proposed payment terms and mechanics.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for circulating the first draft. The structure works for Plaintiff, and we can keep this moving efficiently. Please insert your proposed payment amount and standard payment mechanics in Section 1, and we can then turn the remainder quickly. I’ve also made a few clean-up edits to tighten the release and confidentiality language and make the agreement a bit more market-standard.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount, together with any agreed payment mechanics and timing, as set forth in the final settlement papers.
edits.name: Payment clause placeholder

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases all claims, known or unknown, against Defendant arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this dispute, subject to the express terms of this Agreement.

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement, including the existence and amount of the settlement, shall be treated as strictly confidential, except as required by law or to the parties’ attorneys, tax advisors, insurers, and as otherwise necessary to effectuate this Agreement.

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by Defendant, and Defendant expressly denies any such liability, wrongdoing, or fault.

If you’d like, I can circulate conforming language on that basis once the principal amount is addressed.
